evidence.name: Screen field: Thickness of the picker outline
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Thickness of the picker outline" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Thickness of the picker outline
sections.description: Width in pixels of the outline around the picker container (0-50, default 1). Set it to 0 for no border and rely on the background color alone, or use 1-2px for a clean, defined edge. The border color setting below only takes effect when this is greater than 0.
